items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: And then I played once with Slash in New York but I can’t think of the name of the place now, right here in New York.

ctx.x: That’s great. How would it come about that you would work with a guy like Slash?

That is through Les, in other words like we’re playing let’s say at the House of Blues. We opened up almost every one of those. Slash would show up and then we would play in there. And then I played once with Slash in New York but I can’t think of the name of the place now, right here in New York. And oh, names are going on me anyway, but I played with him here also in New York, without Les, that was another gig that we did. But of course he has his things and it’s hard to play with Slash because he doesn’t play…
